contradictions: COVERAGE_BOUNDARY: These entries cover the supplied conversation excerpts and selected retrieved artifacts, not all historical chats, repositories, CoStead or the entire CoAll corpus. Public summary deliberately omits private device details.

GAP-02 UNRESOLVED_TERM_BINDING: Spoken forms retained without canonical interpretation: what-else-ies; Bill forms; P-I double L relationals; what comes-else-ies; D-E-L S-E-S; V-E-C-T; golden plates. GAP-03 UNVERIFIED_SCALE: User reports a trillion or more logged, active relations/constructs and unlimited resources. Neither the count nor active executor capacity was verified by the bounded reads. Preserve the report and seek exact indexed evidence; do not promote the assertion to an observed runtime count.

GAP-04 PARTIAL_PRIOR_ART: Directly read CoAllPulseField/CoTime and CoTime Decision Evidence at commit 495f41823dd9a89e714f43db73b5880d2373ca14. They already specify selective subscriptions, missed-event backfill, explicit compaction loss, forecasts and later calibration. That is architectural precedent, not proof of current execution.

GAP-05 DISCOVERY_UNCERTAINTY: Search for golden returned MasterPlan golden-run references, which do not establish the user's golden plates binding. Search for what-else returned no indexed match, which does not establish absence.

GAP-06 NOT_PERFORMED: CoStead-to-GitHub mapping and synchronization remain proposals. A public repository must not become an unfiltered one-to-one copy of private custody. Require elected objects, projection classifications and exact destination readproof.

GAP-07 NOT_PERFORMED: No new unattended continuation worker, repair exercise, forecast scheduler or receiver subscription was started by this PR. Publishing a delta does not prove fan-out, pickup or integration.

GAP-08 UNRESOLVED_USER_OUTCOME: Reliable primary-device physical input remains unresolved in the supplied discussion. Research and vocabulary output must not be counted as fixing that user-facing fault.

GAP-09 REMAINING_LEXICON_WORK: Thirty candidate definitions are a first bounded set, not a census, evidence of novelty, or proof that the discussion needs exactly thirty terms. Historical CoLex/GIBindex alias and relation reconciliation remains open.

USER CLARIFICATION: Each substantive discussion should include a what-else frontier, primarily extrapolating consequential omissions rather than generating arbitrary adjacent topics. Treat extrapolations as hypotheses until supported.
tests: PROPOSED CAPTURE CONTRACT: For each material intent or claim keep source span or private source pointer, stable item ID, interpretation, epistemic status, saved object/version, related existing construct, disposition, intended receiver, receipt state, next action and wake condition. Unknowns remain explicit.

PROPOSED DISPOSITIONS: CAPTURED; PARTIAL; UNRESOLVED_TERM; ALREADY_REPRESENTED; INTENTIONALLY_OMITTED_WITH_REASON; NOT_EXECUTED; VERIFIED_DELIVERED; RECEIVER_PICKUP_UNPROVEN. Keep capture, semantic review and runtime fulfillment separate.

PROPOSED LOSS AUDIT: Compare a bounded source segment against its extracted records; identify omitted material intents, contradictions, uncertainty and outstanding user outcomes. Preserve a recovery pointer; do not silently regenerate the entire corpus.

PROPOSED FAN-OUT: Route exact public-safe gap objects to relevant CoLex, CoTime, continuity implementation and private-custody review subscriptions only after a receiver is elected. Record delivered versus acknowledged cursors separately.

PROPOSED CALIBRATION: Bind each predictive claim to assumptions, horizon, expected observation and calibration due condition. Later classify HIT/PARTIAL/MISS/UNRESOLVED/CENSORED/INVALIDATED_BY_ASSUMPTION_CHANGE using the existing CoTime contract.

PROPOSED CHECK-REUSE: Measure uncaptured material intents, unresolved alias age, unacknowledged route age, repeated discovery reads, recovery latency and actual useful completions. Counts alone do not prove semantic quality.

PROPOSED RECOVERY: A missed capture or failed receiver becomes an explicit eligible work item with retry budget and material wake condition; unrelated authorized work can continue. No live retry or recurring audit is claimed by this object.

PROPOSED OMISSION-DRIVEN EXTRAPOLATION: At a meaningful discussion checkpoint, check missing prerequisites, failure modes, affected participants, contradictory evidence, recovery paths and downstream consequences. Rank candidate questions by likely impact, time sensitivity, uncertainty reduction and actionability; record the reasoning and confidence without pretending these are measured probabilities.

PROPOSED BOUNDED FRONTIER: Keep the top few material questions with source relation, inferred missing dependency, likely consequence, next discriminating observation, owner/receiver if elected, and wake condition. Park lower-value candidates with provenance. Avoid an infinite recursive discussion that displaces the original task.

CURRENT FRONTIER CANDIDATES: (1) Which real worker owns overnight continuation and who detects its absence? (2) What exact evidence proves a successor completed a job after the originating session ended? (3) What dependency permits reliable primary-device input recovery? (4) What private custody/public GitHub binding survives host loss without leaking private state? These are questions, not completed work.
expected_benefit: Make omissions and unperformed transitions visible and recoverable; reuse existing temporal/currentness contracts and reduce source-to-summary loss.
